Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤔. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🙏."

JACK:
"I don't want to take it. I don't want to be a slave to these pills 💔."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you need to take your medication. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤯."

JACK:
"I don't need it. I'm fine. I just want to be free 🌟."

Dr. Smith's expression turns stern, but Jack's words strike a chord within him 🤷‍♂️. He realizes that Jack's refusal is not just about the medication, but about the fear of losing control 🌪️.

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, I'll take it myself. I'll show you that it's safe 💊."

Dr. Smith picks up the glass and downs the medication in one swift motion 💥. He waits for a few moments, expecting nothing to happen 🕰️.

But as he opens his eyes, he's met with an eerie silence 🗣️. Jack is gone, vanished into thin air 🔮. Dr. Smith looks around the room, disoriented and confused 🤯.

Suddenly, it hits him - the medication, the hospital, the entire world - it's all just a product of his own fractured mind 🌪️. He's been living in a delusional world, and Jack was just a manifestation of his own paranoia 🤔.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth 🤯. He's been the one who's been sick all along, and Jack was just a figment of his own imagination 🎭.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
